## Checklist
- [ ] `node --test` passes (zero dependencies, Node 22+)
- [ ] Reference implementation still conforms to `spec/orf-v0.1.md` (or the spec is updated to match)
- [ ] No secrets in code or history
- [ ] If proposing a spec change, the motivation includes a concrete case the current spec handles poorly
